PROJECT LAHIO 1.2 RC2 "POWER" - A Finnish town, 1955-1990
=====================================================================

An isometric sandbox city builder for Windows 98. Build a Finnish town from
the post-war wooden suburbs to the concrete lahio estates. You are the
President: officially above politics, in practice deciding everything.

NEW IN 1.2 "POWER"
  Coal power station (3x3, from 1962, Town): 2,000 units, four small
    plants in one, cheaper to run.
  Peat power plant (from 1972, Market town): 1,000 units, domestic fuel
    immune to oil and coal prices; the Rural bloc approves.
  Nuclear power plant (from 1977, Regional centre, on a shore): 5,000
    units. The Ministry first asks: Eastern, Western or the Loviisa
    compromise?
  Oil power plant has its own art. Guide (F4): Tab to "The power works".
  Railway crossings: drag a road straight across the track for a level
    crossing (a motorway gets a bridge); power lines cross it too.

NEW IN 1.1 "HARDER TIMES"
  Difficulty: choose Easy (= version 1.0), Normal or Hard in New Game.
  Winter: December-March, snow scenery, power and heat demand peaks,
    hard winters announced in the November paper, frozen pipes.
  The Sweden years 1969-70, and rising expectations in 1975, 1980, 1985,
    each announced in the newspaper a year ahead.
  Settings: "Winter scenery" can be switched off.

REQUIREMENTS
  Windows 98 SE, Pentium II 233 MHz or faster, 128 MB RAM (the game uses up
  to 40 MB), DirectX 6.1 or newer, a DirectDraw card with 16 MB video memory,
  16-bit colour. Sound card optional.

INSTALLING
  Installer: run lahio-<version>-setup.exe (Start menu shortcuts, uninstall
    in Control Panel; your saves are kept on upgrade). Silent: /S,
    folder: /D=C:\GAMES\LAHIO, remove: /UNINSTALL.
  Portable: unzip lahio-<version>.zip anywhere and run LAHIO\LAHIO.EXE.

RUNNING
  Fullscreen 800x600.
  Options: -window  -res 640 / -res 1024  -fps 30
  Settings are saved in LAHIO.INI next to the game. Saves from 1.0 load
  as Easy; saves from 1.1 load unchanged.

FIRST STEPS
  R + drag      lay a road from the national road
  H / A / C / I zone houses, apartments, shops, industry
  P             power lines and plants     W   water pipes, pumps, heat
  S             services                   V   show zones
  Right-click   on any building: what it needs to grow
  F4            the Guide (Tab: pages)      E  services panel   G  graphs
  Space pause, F1-F3 speed, Ctrl+Z undo, +/- zoom, Esc menu (save/load)
  Read the January newspaper: the Cabinet humbly advises the President.

https://github.com/HenriVSL/project-lahio
Designed and directed by Henri Lavikainen; developed with Claude (Anthropic)
coding agents. All companies, products and people in the game are fictional.
